_comment: Citation / source registry for the knowledge base. Every source_id used in a plant file under data/knowledge_base/ must resolve here. 'basis' records what was actually read: full text of the cited pages, or the PubMed abstract only.

who-v4.title: WHO monographs on selected medicinal plants, Volume 4

retrieval.method: Full-text PDF (456 pages, text layer) from a third-party scan at https://www.survivorlibrary.com/library/who-monographs-on-selected-medicinal-plants-volume-4.pdf, text extracted locally. WHO's own server returned HTTP 403, so the official copy was not retrieved.
retrieval.basis: full text of the cited pages

who-v4.notes: Cited with printed page numbers. Greek-letter prefixes (alpha, beta) are lost in the text layer, so isomer prefixes are not reproduced. Verify against the official WHO IRIS copy before publication.

who-v4-guavae.title: Folium Guavae (guava leaf, Psidium guajava L.), in WHO monographs on selected medicinal plants, Volume 4
who-v4-guavae.notes: Covers the dried and/or young leaves.

who-v4-ricini.title: Oleum Ricini (castor oil, fixed oil from the seeds of Ricinus communis L.), in WHO monographs on selected medicinal plants, Volume 4
who-v4-ricini.notes: Covers ONLY the fixed oil obtained by cold expression from the seeds. It does not cover the leaf, raw seed or other plant parts.

who-v4-cumulative-index.title: Annex 2, cumulative index of monographs in Volumes 1-4 (alphabetical order of plant name)
who-v4-cumulative-index.notes: Used to confirm which plants have WHO monographs. Lists no monograph for Solanum lycopersicum (tomato).

dimpsar-table2.title: DIMPSAR: Dataset for Indian medicinal plant species analysis and recognition (Table 2, 80 species)
dimpsar-table2.authors: Pushpa B R, Shobha Rani N
dimpsar-table2.notes: Identity of the image classes only (folder to species). Not a source for any medicinal or safety statement. See docs/kb/coverage_plan.md.
